text:
emily: Heads-up — CVE-2029-1234 in httpx. We use httpx in inference-gateway, kms-client, and metrics-forwarder. Potential SSRF/token-exfil vector reported. Can we triage impact + decide patch windows?

raj: Acknowledged. Initial read: upstream says SSRF via uncontrolled redirect + trust_env. Low CVSS if no open redirect, but because kms-client does token exchange we need to assume high-sensitivity. I'll run dependency map.

sara: Product question: SLA impact if we need rolling restarts? Dedicated customers expect narrower windows. If restarts are ~10s per pod we might be fine; if image rebuilds add drift we need to schedule.

alex: Quick grep: httpx present in packages: inference-gateway, kms-client, metrics-forwarder. kms-client used for token exchange to external KMS endpoints.

ops-bot: Created ISSUE-4321 for tracking https://tracker.internal/ISSUE-4321 :rotating_light:

emily: Proposal: prioritize kms-client patch -> inference-gateway -> metrics-forwarder. Canary in us-west-2 (5% traffic) then ramp 25% -> 100%. Need to confirm whether bump is hotpatchable or requires restart (my guess: image rebuild + restart).

raj: Confirmed upstream fix is in httpx 0.26.8. We must rebuild images. No in-process hotpatch available. Estimate: PR + CI ~2h, canary + verification ~30-45m, full roll ~1-2h per env.

sara: Recommend scheduling for the next maintenance window: Sat 02:00 UTC for hosted. For Dedicated: send 72h notice and offer a private maintenance slot for Tier 1 (enterprise/regulatory).

alex: For Dedicated rollout plan:
```
- Tier 1: coordinateprivate window, opt-in, no auto-update
- Tier 2: auto-apply with 7d notice
- Canary region: us-west-2 at 5% traffic
```

emily: Audit + RBAC considerations: enable extra token-exchange audit logs for 48h post-rollout, and tighten service-account egress permissions during the rollout. Add an IaC change for the service-account role to limit outbound access to KMS endpoints only.

raj: I'll open PRs now: https://git.internal/r/redwood/kms-client/pull/432 (bump httpx + tests) and https://git.internal/r/redwood/inference-gateway/pull/987 (bump + smoke). Smoke test will hit the token endpoint and verify no redirect behavior.

raj: Smoke test snippet:
```
# smoke test (run in canary namespace)
kubectl exec -n canary deploy/inference-gateway -- curl -sS -D - http://127.0.0.1:8080/health || exit 1
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-gateway -n canary --watch
```

ops-bot: CI pipeline queued, jobs: unit-tests, integration-smoke, e2e-security-scans. :white_check_mark:

emily: Communication plan: Hosted customers — status page + short maintenance banner. Dedicated customers — email + account channel. Sara can you draft messages and the status page entry? Mention: no evidence of exploit in logs so far.

sara: On it. Draft will say: "Security update: patching httpx (CVE-2029-1234). Rolling updates planned Sat 02:00 UTC. No active exploit detected. Enterprise customers will receive separate scheduling options"

alex: Quick log query I ran to scope exposure: `index=prod source=app "httpx" | stats count by service` — metrics-forwarder shows ~12k hits last 24h, kms-client ~2k, inference-gateway ~900. We'll prioritize metrics-forwarder follow-up but kms-client first.

raj: If we find suspicious requests (redirect + token requests), escalate to incident and pause rollout. Also capture network pcap for any anomalies during canary.

emily: Next steps:
- raj: merge PRs + ensure smoke tests by EOD (1958767345).
- ops: schedule canary at Sat 02:00 UTC and prepare rollback playbook.
- sara: publish customer notices (72h for Dedicated).
- alex: run targeted log queries pre/post rollout.

emily: We'll sync in #sec-standup at 10:30 UTC tomorrow. Thanks all. :pray:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Patch window Sat 02:00 UTC — httpx CVE-2029-1234" (scheduled for 1958780000)
